description: §48.6.4 / §7.3.1 — nested function declarations hoist to the enclosing function body's local scope: `isEven` calls `isOdd`, declared after it, and back (mutual recursion with no source-order constraint). parity(4) = "even", parity(7) = "odd": trace = "even;odd;".
rationale: §48.6.4: 'Inner `fn` declarations (nested inside an outer `fn` body, per §7.3.1) hoist to the enclosing `fn` body's local scope, not to the file scope'; §7.3.1: an inner function closes over the outer body's bindings with standard JavaScript closure semantics (a function declaration is hoisted to its block).
